paragraphs: In Sanhedrin 77b he speaks in Rav’s name. Dikdukei Soferim cites from a manuscript the reading Rav Chinena bar Shelamya, who Hyman says was in fact Rav’s student.[^1]

notes.text: William Davidson Sanhedrin 77b names Rav Chinena bar Yehudah speaking in Rav’s name. The manuscript reading attributed to Dikdukei Soferim and the identification of its bearer as Rav’s student are Hyman’s report and argument; neither a manuscript collation nor an identity merge is made here.
